title: Equivalent and simplifying fractions
subtitle: Split or merge the pieces. The amount stays the same.

explanation.title: Same amount, different pieces
paragraphs: Use the diagrams to split and merge equal pieces.

method.title: Find → Divide top → Divide bottom → Repeat

steps.title: Find
steps.text: Choose a whole number greater than 1 that divides both numbers.

steps.title: Divide the top
steps.text: Divide the numerator by the number you chose.

steps.title: Divide the bottom
steps.text: Divide the denominator by the same number.

steps.title: Repeat
steps.text: Keep going until no whole number greater than 1 divides both numbers.

interactive.title: Simplify the fraction
interactive.intro: The support is removed one step at a time. Use the fraction bars to see what each division does.

worked_examples.title: Simplify 18/24 in more than one step
steps: Divide both numbers by 2 to get 9/12.
9/12 is not finished because 9 and 12 both divide by 3.
Divide both numbers by 3 to get 3/4.

worked_examples.title: Check 5/7
steps: No whole number greater than 1 divides both 5 and 7.
The fraction is already fully simplified.

worked_examples.title: Do not subtract from both numbers
steps: Subtracting 1 changes 6/10 into 5/9, which is a different value.
To simplify, divide both numbers by the same number.

question_bank.title: Practise equivalent and simplifying fractions
question_bank.intro: Answer one question at a time. Simplify fully and check that the numerator and denominator have no common divisor greater than 1.
